data.title: Greenside Residences
data.about:
Step into a world of serenity at the Greenside Residence by Emaar, centrally located in the vibrant heart of the Dubai Hills Estate. Offering 1 to 3 bedroom golfside apartments, these havens of luxury stand as a testament to premium living. 

As you explore Emaar Greenside apartments for sale, you'll uncover a life of unparalleled luxury, blending modern urban comfort with breathtaking scenic vistas. Immerse yourself in the suburban bliss, surrounded by lush greenery and open spaces that offer not just a home, but a retreat from the everyday. Don't miss the opportunity to own a slice of paradise at Greenside Residence at Dubai Hills Estate, where every day brings joy, peace, and the luxury you've always dreamed of.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury Golfside Apartments in Dubai Hills Estate
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• 1 to 3 Bedroom apartments starting from AED 1.4M
  • Crafted for modern living in a verdant setting, celebrating the finer aspects of life
  • Opulent lobby complemented by a stylish residents' lounge for contemporary comfort
  • Dual 15-story contemporary towers, housing a range of amenities and direct access to retail outlets
  • A pinnacle of modern architecture, driven by a commitment to sustainability
  • Flexible layouts conceived to enhance the quality of living
  • Neutral-tone finishes and materials chosen for both their visual appeal and efficiency

location_tile.title: Stay at Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Greenside Residences by Emaar exudes luxury. You'll be just minutes from the dynamic core of Downtown Dubai, as well as vital commercial, shopping, and tourism centres, if you stay at Dubai Hills Estate, which is conveniently linked to Al Khail Road. Furthermore, the nearby Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro lines guarantee quick access to airports and neighbouring emirates. Within walking distance of this wonderful neighbourhood are three international schools and a daycare, offering the ideal atmosphere for your family to develop and prosper.

  • 15 minutes from Dubai Downtown
  • 20  minutes from  Dubai Int’l Airports
  • 15 minutes from Dubai Marina
  • 25 minutes fromDistrict 2020
